analysis_type: Joint ellipsoid support for the linear part of native Roszman1 arctangent predictions, combined with frozen argument intervals and intersected with stage-46 independent envelopes; no full nonlinear optimum, probability or finite bound for the crossing fold

joint_support_rule.linear_part: Define A(theta,x)=b1-b2*x. At each held-out x, compute exact ellipsoid support A_min and A_max from center_A plus or minus radius*sqrt(v(x)^T*C*v(x)), with v=(1,-x,0,0), instead of taking independent b1 and b2 corners
joint_support_rule.argument_interval: Reuse the stage-46 argument_minimum and argument_maximum for z=b3/(x-b4), which were computed from independent b3 and denominator intervals under the certified nonzero sign
joint_support_rule.alternative_bound: Because arctan is increasing, use alternative_min=A_min-arctan_max/pi and alternative_max=A_max-arctan_min/pi with outward rounding
joint_support_rule.intersection: Intersect the alternative with the stage-46 independent envelope by taking the maximum lower bound and minimum upper bound; require nonempty intervals and center-prediction containment
joint_support_rule.sign_gate: Construct alternatives only where x-b4 has a certified nonzero sign over the full ellipsoid and closed x interval. Fold 5 remains unavailable and receives no finite prediction or residual bound
joint_support_rule.scope: The linear part is jointly supported, but the argument relaxation and their sum are not a joint full nonlinear global optimum

candidate_rule.direction_formula: For each parameter p in {b1,b2,b3,b4} and each sign, use theta_candidate=theta_center+sign*radius*(C*e_p)/sqrt(C_pp); all parameters may move through the covariance direction
candidate_rule.feasibility: Require every candidate to have full ellipsoid quadratic form 16 within the high-precision tolerance and to preserve the certified nonzero denominator sign at evaluated distances
candidate_rule.evaluation: Evaluate the original native model at every available held-out x and every candidate, using high-precision arithmetic and cross-checking the frozen native_model implementation
candidate_rule.containment: Require all candidates to remain inside the stage-46 independent envelope, the joint-linear alternative and the intersection; record violations instead of hiding them
candidate_rule.unavailable_preservation: Do not create candidates, alternatives or intersections for fold 5 as a substitute for its unavailable finite bound
candidate_rule.scope: Candidates are implementation-consistency witnesses, not global optimizers or the analytic support proof

comparison_rule.alternative_comparison: Compare alternative widths with stage-46 independent widths and preserve every outcome, including any wider or unchanged case
comparison_rule.intersection_comparison: Report intersection width ratio and reduction for every available x; unchanged intersections remain valid
comparison_rule.point_accounting: Retain all 25 held-out observations: 20 available points and 5 unavailable points in fold 5. No unavailable point may be silently removed or assigned a finite residual bound
comparison_rule.historical_preservation: Do not rewrite the stage-46 baseline, receipts, protocols, reports, figures or Word documents

numerical_rule.engine: Use 80-digit mpmath arithmetic, exact linear support and frozen argument intervals
numerical_rule.outward_rounding: Apply the 1e-24 relative margin and nextafter outward conversion to certified lower and upper values
numerical_rule.certificate_class: High-precision numerical conservative interval, not exact rational algebra or a probability region
numerical_rule.sign_gate: Reject any alternative when x-b4 has no certified nonzero sign; never evaluate a logarithm, reciprocal or arctan across a singular denominator
numerical_rule.native_crosscheck: Cross-check center and candidate predictions against the frozen native_model implementation

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生Roszman1联合线性反正切交集_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, changed centers, covariance matrices, folds, denominator intervals or post-hoc candidate directions
No finite alternative, intersection or residual bound for fold 5 or any crossing denominator
No coordinate-only candidate directions that ignore off-diagonal covariance
No calling the joint-linear alternative or intersection a full nonlinear global optimum
No assumption that the alternative or intersection is tighter everywhere
No hiding of unavailable points, wider alternatives, unchanged intersections or candidate violations
No probability, confidence, posterior, calibrated-coverage, independent-model-family or independent-experiment claim
No exact rational-certificate claim or replacement of historical baselines
